notes: No release before 0.5.0 may claim any of this is balanced: every magnitude in the shipped content carries tuningStatus untuned and the balance harness owns all of them -- so this file is a measurement and not a balance claim.

The universe is still degenerate in the following ways, and this edit closes two of them and withdraws two statements the superseded files made. The fast and horizon sweeps are 100 percent passive-control and submit no god verb; the ascension sweep round-robins all eight strategies, which is the one place a strategy is exercised at all, and the superseded files called all three passive. Scribing no longer stops for good when the stock empties: the single materials pool is now food, stone and vellum and a scribe spends only vellum, so over the reference two hundred years the final twenty-year window scribes 5 books where it used to scribe none. Portals now open. The superseded files say nothing in packages/scenario opens one and that no raid runs in any committed sweep, and that is no longer true: raids.ts installs the arrival process and drives rules-raid to termination, and the executor declares raidEngagement true by default. Teaching does not die out either -- but the superseded files' statement that a lesson is taught in every one of the ten twenty-year windows, the thinnest holding 16, is withdrawn as false. It held for one run seed. Three of five seeds violate it on the tree those files were measured on, and three of five violate it here. Teaching supply oscillates and a two-hundred-year horizon can end inside a trough; packages/scenario/test/unit/reference-long-run.test.ts carries the seeds, the per-window supply counts and the three explanations they rule out.

knowledgeKind has no consumer in the rules path. When metis-knowledge is implemented, scribing refusal and succession loss will change these numbers for real, and that regeneration will be a behaviour claim in a way this one is not.
rationale:
The economy wire arriving in the gate sweeps, regenerated once from the merged tree. The merge took main's three baselines as an explicit placeholder rather than hand-merging this branch's against them, so every delta recorded here is this tree against main at 9f6b5ba -- a comparison somebody can reproduce -- and not against an intermediate nobody ran. The content set changed and the digest says so, 5c319f8275e05ddef2a166dd7552942b -> 6973d2c55f6d7788bbaa6886e507bbde: fourteen form.json records gained yieldWeights, five territory.json records gained yieldPerLandUnit, and seven raid constants that make a raid fire were added. main's own two node.json passes -- knowledgeKind on all 300 records, then twenty-nine of them judged metis -- came across this merge and moved nothing measurable: every delta below is identical to the digit to the same comparison run against main before those passes landed, which is what a field no rules-path code reads is supposed to do. Two things did change at once and the split between them is not measured here: the economy wire, and raids firing in a committed sweep for the first time -- main's executor declares raidEngagement false because nothing there opens a portal, and this tree's declares it true. Attributing the movements below to one or the other wants the A/B the executor already carries, a run built with raids false, and that is a measurement rather than a merge. No tolerance was widened, and no constant, cap or magnitude was tuned to produce any movement below.

What moved at five world years is scribing and what it produces. referenceGrimoires 93.21 -> 90.97 (-2.24, -1.39 SE) and referenceKnowledgeInstances 312.46 -> 310.255 (-2.205, -1.05 SE): the single materials stock is now three kinds and a scribe spends only vellum, so at this horizon she competes for a third of a pool instead of all of it, and the direction is down here for the same reason it is up at two hundred years where scribing used to stop for good around world year seventy. Everything else is inside a third of a standard error. referencePopulation and referencePopulationChange each rise 0.13 (0.28 SE), referenceNodesGained and referenceNodesKnown each rise 0.025 (0.22 SE), referenceLivingMages falls 0.02 (-0.20 SE), and referenceLibraryDepth (5.28) and referencePeakPopulation (216) do not move at all.
